flag: n=3 female test speakers — within-sample, not a population claim
speaker_count_note: AudioMNIST is 48 male / 12 female speakers dataset-wide; this analysis, like the rest of the sex-direction analyses, follows the speaker-disjoint SI test fold (n=9 male / n=3 female, 4500/1500 utterances). Note this test barely depends on female n -- see module docstring.
excluded_note: resnet1d and crnn_gru EXCLUDED from this analysis: their whitened sex direction sat INSIDE the random-re-split null in the re-split control, so there is no validated direction whose readout sensitivity would be meaningful. Stated explicitly.
bound_note: This test bounds ONLY the linear readout's sensitivity to the penultimate sex direction. It does NOT establish whether earlier layers route sex-correlated features upstream of digit features -- that is a distinct, unaddressed question.
head_method_note: Both classifier heads are 3-layer MLPs (Linear-ReLU-Dropout x2 then Linear), not a single linear map from penultimate to logits, so 'W' is operationalized as the Jacobian d(logits)/d(penultimate) of the REAL trained head, averaged over the SI test fold (J_mean, 10xd) -- s_k = |J_mean_k . u_hat|, the direct analog of the linear-readout formula.
